command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; LINE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])shizuku_server$' | head -n1 || true); echo shizuku_server_line="$LINE"; printf '%s' "$LINE" | grep -Eq '^shell[[:space:]]+'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_voice_guard_pre_call=true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(state); echo live_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && ACTIVE=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; POST=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$POST"; printf '%s
' "$POST" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$POST" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$POST" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_live_probe true --ei shizuku_live_duration_ms 5000 >/dev/null; sleep 8; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; MID=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$MID" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$MID" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$MID" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'AiCallBridge.*(shizuku_live_probe_result|probe=|error=|service_uid=|service_pid=|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|pre_dtmf_|post_dtmf_|uplink_|media_ok_|privileged_uid=|live_parity_ok=)' | tail -n 180 || true); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'error='; then exit 31; fi; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'probe=shizuku-user-service-live-v1'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'service_uid=2000'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_after_start=true'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_start=true'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'pre_dtmf_bytes_read=80000'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'post_dtmf_bytes_read=80000'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_bytes_written=9600'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'media_ok_before_endpoint_close=true'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'live_parity_ok=true'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; sleep 1; test "$(state)" = "0"; trap - EXIT; echo phase2c_shizuku_live_silent_parity_ok=true
